name: 70462 · Springfield, LA
findings: ZIP 70462 (Springfield) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70462 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70462 (Springfield) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
